# P8C Portal read-only RBAC — exact allowlist (get/list only, no wildcard verbs).
# Matches docs/architecture/p8c/rbac-design.yaml. Velero namespace confirmed at G0 = velero.
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: portal-reader
  namespace: portal
automountServiceAccountToken: false
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: portal-migrator
  namespace: portal
automountServiceAccountToken: false
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: portal-platform-reader
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: [nodes, persistentvolumes, pods, services, persistentvolumeclaims, events]
  verbs: [get, list]
- apiGroups: [storage.k8s.io]
  resources: [storageclasses]
  verbs: [get, list]
- apiGroups: [apps]
  resources: [deployments, statefulsets, daemonsets, replicasets]
  verbs: [get, list]
- apiGroups: [batch]
  resources: [jobs, cronjobs]
  verbs: [get, list]
- apiGroups: [discovery.k8s.io]
  resources: [endpointslices]
  verbs: [get, list]
- apiGroups: [snapshot.storage.k8s.io]
  resources: [volumesnapshots]
  verbs: [get, list]
- apiGroups: [metrics.k8s.io]
  resources: [nodes, pods]
  verbs: [get, list]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata:
  name: portal-platform-reader
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: portal-reader
  namespace: portal
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: portal-platform-reader
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: portal-db-reader
  namespace: portal
rules:
- apiGroups: [postgresql.cnpg.io]
  resources: [clusters]
  resourceNames: [portal-db]
  verbs: [get]
- apiGroups: [postgresql.cnpg.io]
  resources: [scheduledbackups]
  resourceNames: [portal-db-daily]
  verbs: [get]
- apiGroups: [postgresql.cnpg.io]
  resources: [backups]
  verbs: [get, list]
- apiGroups: [barmancloud.cnpg.io]
  resources: [objectstores]
  resourceNames: [portal-db-backup]
  verbs: [get]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: portal-db-reader
  namespace: portal
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: portal-reader
  namespace: portal
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: Role
  name: portal-db-reader
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: portal-ingress-reader
  namespace: portal
rules:
- apiGroups: [gateway.networking.k8s.io]
  resources: [gateways]
  resourceNames: [portal-gateway]
  verbs: [get]
- apiGroups: [gateway.networking.k8s.io]
  resources: [httproutes]
  resourceNames: [portal]
  verbs: [get]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: portal-ingress-reader
  namespace: portal
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: portal-reader
  namespace: portal
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: Role
  name: portal-ingress-reader
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: portal-velero-reader
  namespace: velero
rules:
- apiGroups: [velero.io]
  resources: [backupstoragelocations, backups, restores]
  verbs: [get, list]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: portal-velero-reader
  namespace: velero
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: portal-reader
  namespace: portal
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: Role
  name: portal-velero-reader

# P8C Portal ingress (dedicated Gateway + HTTPRoute) and dedicated UI demo PKI.
# TLS terminate on Gateway; certificateRefs portal/portal-ui-tls. Port 80 not exposed.
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Gateway
metadata:
  name: portal-gateway
  namespace: portal
spec:
  gatewayClassName: eg
  listeners:
  - name: https
    port: 443
    protocol: HTTPS
    hostname: portal.demo-pak.test
    tls:
      mode: Terminate
      certificateRefs:
      - kind: Secret
        name: portal-ui-tls
    allowedRoutes:
      namespaces:
        from: Same
---
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: portal
  namespace: portal
spec:
  parentRefs:
  - name: portal-gateway
    sectionName: https
  hostnames:
  - portal.demo-pak.test
  rules:
  - matches:
    - path:
        type: PathPrefix
        value: /
    backendRefs:
    - name: portal
      port: 80
---
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Issuer
metadata:
  name: portal-ui-bootstrap
  namespace: portal
spec:
  selfSigned: {}
---
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Certificate
metadata:
  name: portal-ui-root
  namespace: portal
spec:
  isCA: true
  commonName: PAK Portal P8C Demo UI Root
  secretName: portal-ui-ca
  duration: 8760h
  renewBefore: 720h
  privateKey:
    algorithm: ECDSA
    size: 256
    rotationPolicy: Always
  usages:
  - cert sign
  - crl sign
  issuerRef:
    name: portal-ui-bootstrap
    kind: Issuer
    group: cert-manager.io
---
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Issuer
metadata:
  name: portal-ui-ca
  namespace: portal
spec:
  ca:
    secretName: portal-ui-ca
---
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Certificate
metadata:
  name: portal-ui-server
  namespace: portal
spec:
  secretName: portal-ui-tls
  dnsNames:
  - portal.demo-pak.test
  duration: 720h
  renewBefore: 168h
  privateKey:
    algorithm: ECDSA
    size: 256
    rotationPolicy: Always
  usages:
  - digital signature
  - server auth
  issuerRef:
    name: portal-ui-ca
    kind: Issuer
    group: cert-manager.io

# P8C Deployment Gate — DRAFT (NOT_AUTHORIZED_FOR_EXECUTION)

Дата: 2026-11-03. Исполнитель подготовки: PRIMARY HERMES. Status: DRAFT.
Источники: portal/manifests/{networkpolicy,deployment,gateway,rbac}.yaml, P8_PORTAL_DB_CONTRACT.md,
config.go, store.go, migrations.go, server.go, main.go.

```text

NETPOL_APPROVED_FOR_APPLY=NO · PRODUCTION_MIGRATION_DEPLOYMENT=NOT_AUTHORIZED
```

Generated Service/Pods (EnvoyProxy dataplane) — selectors/owner UID из §1 design; имена заранее не угадывать.

## DEP-02 — RBAC matrix (subject system:serviceaccount:portal:portal-reader)

Allowed (get/list; named reads):
- core: nodes, persistentvolumes, pods, services, persistentvolumeclaims, events
- storage.k8s.io: storageclasses; snapshot.storage.k8s.io: volumesnapshots; metrics.k8s.io: nodes, pods
- apps: deployments, statefulsets, daemonsets, replicasets; batch: jobs, cronjobs
- discovery.k8s.io: endpointslices
- postgresql.cnpg.io: clusters (name portal-db), scheduledbackups (name portal-db-daily), backups (get/list)
- barmancloud.cnpg.io: objectstores (name portal-db-backup)
- gateway.networking.k8s.io: gateways (name portal-gateway), httproutes (name portal)
- velero.io: backupstoragelocations, backups, restores

Denied: secrets, configmaps, serviceaccounts/token, pods/exec, pods/proxy, create/update/patch/delete
(все mutation verbs), любые resourceNames вне перечисленных, любые namespace вне portal+velero.

Authz-механизм (operator, не actual mutation): `SubjectAccessReview` authorization.k8s.io/v1 от operator
для portal-reader; конечное число reviews (≤ 20), по одному на allowed-verb/denied-verb случай; mutation
НЕ выполняется, destructive объект не создаётся ради отказа.

## DEP-03 — Migration + schema

- version = 1, checksum = `53e37c762d9efd4f8985ad848d33a6a3604c4554e65accb39429d14d62dfdbe7`
  (sha256 embedded SQL0001), source_revision `^[0-9a-f]{40}$`.
- Proof: Job `portal migrate` exit 0 → ledger row (version=1, checksum exact) → `VerifySchema`
  (main.go validateMigration) подтверждает таблицы/колонки/constraints. Read-only ledger query:
  `SELECT version, checksum FROM portal.schema_migrations ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1` (store.go).
  Ожидание — версия+checksum exact, не только exit 0.

## DEP-04 — DB TLS (verify-full) — доказательство, не только readiness

pinned config: DBHost=portal-db-rw.portal.svc:5432, sslmode=verify-full, sslrootcert=/etc/portal/db/ca.crt,
ServerName(SNI)=portal-db-rw.portal.svc, sslsni=1, MinVersion=TLS1.2, InsecureSkipVerify=false, Fallbacks=0
(poolConfig отклоняет ambient PG/no-fallback/insecure). Proof = успешное установление verify-full pool
(миграция/VerifySchema через этот pool успешны ⇒ cert/hostname проверены; иначе connection fail).
`/readyz` 200 = migration+collector OK, НЕ самостоятельное доказательство verify-full. `ssl=true` ≠ hostname
verification. App DB signal = store.Ping (pool.Ping, 3s). Без superuser, Secret export, exec.

## DEP-05 — UI/auth/11 API + events + bounds

- 11 API (server.go): /api/v1/{health,summary,nodes,workloads,pods,services,storage,backups,database,metrics,events}
  — Basic Auth (401 missing/wrong → 200 valid), GET/HEAD only, 405 иначе.
- mgmt: /livez,/readyz,/startupz на 8081 (НЕ открывать через внешний Service). `/healthz` отсутствует.
- UI: `/` + `/assets/*` (200). TLS trust/hostname: Gateway hostname portal.demo-pak.test, TLS Terminate.
- Owner credential ввод: secret-safe (без argv/log/evidence), auth verifier hex SHA-256 из secretKeyRef.
- Events persistence: timeline_events (dedup_key UNIQUE, TTL 7d, cap 50000, prune ≤1000/statement),
  observation_batches (TTL 7d, cap 20000); readback ListEvents keyset (id DESC, afterID); EventRow fields
  (ingestedAt, sourceTime, source, severity, objectKind/NS/Name, reasonCode, occurrences, message).
  Без создания искусственных K8s событий/mutations.
- Bounds: наследуются из accepted plan HC-* (request timeout min(15s, remaining W); W=60/30/120s;
  Gateway 120s×12); конечное число проверок; expiry = завершение одного approved run.

# P8C Runtime-Readiness Gate — DRAFT (NOT_AUTHORIZED_FOR_EXECUTION)

Дата: 2026-11-03. Исполнитель подготовки: PRIMARY HERMES. Status: DRAFT.
METRIC_SOURCE_CHOICE=ACCEPTED_SOURCE_ONLY (cnpg_pg_stat_archiver_*).

```text
RUNTIME_READINESS_GATE=NOT_AUTHORIZED_FOR_EXECUTION
PHASE2_NEW_RUN_APPROVED=NO · NETPOL_APPROVED_FOR_APPLY=NO
```

## RD-01 — WAL observation (cnpg_pg_stat_archiver_*) — числа и verdict

Series (CNPG v1.30.1 default-monitoring.yaml, blob 91fc65b07b0b69c218c6eb407df004b808b510f7):
`cnpg_pg_stat_archiver_archived_count`, `_failed_count`, `_last_archived_time`, `_last_failed_time`, `_stats_reset_time`.

| Аспект | Значение (проектное, source-only) |
|---|---|
| endpoint (source-backed) | `http://portal-db-metrics.portal.svc:9187/metrics` (config.go default `MetricsServiceURL`; P8B historical HTTP). TLS в текущей конфигурации НЕ доказан → CA/SNI не изобретать; future compatibility: если endpoint станет TLS, verify без opportunistic HTTP fallback / verify=false, несовпадение → STOP |
| actor | основной Hermes через принятый key-only operator path (не Portal Pod-IP) |
| per-request timeout | 5s (metrics.go) |
| max body / total bytes | 1 MiB на ответ (metrics.go) / ≤ 5 MiB всего |
| N (samples) | 2 на стадию: baseline (до) + post-step (после); максимум 3 при неоднозначности |
| W (hard deadline) | 5s на запрос; общая стадия-срок = deployment stage, не отдельный wall-clock |
| I (interval baseline→post) | max(300s, длительность стадии), верхняя граница 600s (archive_timeout=300s; без бесконечного ожидания) |
| freshness | last_archived_time сравнивается с baseline-значением этапа (не с GET-time) |
| verdict PASS | archived_count вырос И last_archived_time > baseline last_archived_time |
| verdict FAIL | failed_count вырос ИЛИ last_failed_time продвинулся (не маскировать за ростом archived_count) |
| parse error/NaN | INCONCLUSIVE (не PASS, не FAIL) |
| HTTP/network timeout | INCONCLUSIVE (retry в пределах W, затем INCONCLUSIVE) |
| counter reset (stats_reset_time изменился) | INCONCLUSIVE (series restarted) |
| role/UID/restart change | INCONCLUSIVE (backend сменился, не сравнивать как одну series) |
| idle (нет роста) | INCONCLUSIVE/STOP (не force WAL, не бесконечное ожидание) |
| запрет | без искусственного WAL switch/write/backup |

Стабильный backend между samples обязателен. archive_command = ограниченный proxy результата
архивирования, НЕ независимый S3 readback и НЕ DNS proof; DNS resolution и S3-operation — разные факты.

**ACCESS_METHOD=UNRESOLVED** (частично): endpoint и series определены, но привязка к стабильному
primary backend не решена. Метрика pg_stat_archiver meaningful только на primary; Service
`portal-db-metrics` (selector `cnpg.io/cluster=portal-db`, deployment.yaml, PLANNED) round-robins и
НЕ дискриминирует primary. Точный вопрос для Architect/Owner: механизм primary-bound metrics read —
(a) первичный-selector Service/EndpointSlice, либо (b) operator-side read primary Pod metrics —
без Portal Pod-IP pinning (DB contract) и без нового collector. До этого выбора read остаётся NOT_AUTHORIZED;
все bounds/verdict/series выше завершены независимо.

## RD-02 — baseline (PR-3/5/6 + HC-*), без изменений

PR-3/5/6 и HC-DB/ARCH-STATE/WAL-PROGRESS/OP/DNS/PORTAL/GW — по accepted plan; численные bounds
наследуются (request timeout min(15s, remaining W); W=60/30/120s; I=10/5/10s; N=6; Gateway 120s×12).
Эти проверки остаются NEW_PROPOSAL / NOT_AUTHORIZED. Execution wrapper — отдельный prerequisite.

## Статус

